snap_cli.rationale: The immutable fixture has only p50 and seven runs; it cannot support a p95 request SLO.
promotion_requires: p50 and p95 in one immutable fixture
profile, binary digest, corpus, host class, and isolation provenance
an absolute gate checked by the producer

cold_index.scenario: target/release/graphzero index . against a newly created isolated empty benchmark store
cold_index.rationale: Cold indexing is corpus-sensitive setup work and the immutable fixture has seven samples with no normalized files-per-second or bytes-per-second contract.
promotion_requires: p50 and p95 plus normalized corpus throughput
profile, binary digest, corpus, host class, and isolation provenance
an absolute or normalized gate checked by the producer

warm_reindex.scenario: target/release/graphzero index . against an already indexed tracked corpus
warm_reindex.rationale: Warm reindex is maintenance work and the immutable fixture has seven samples without a dedicated p95 field or normalized changed-file workload.
promotion_requires: p50 and p95 plus an explicit changed-file workload
profile, binary digest, corpus, host class, and isolation provenance
an absolute or normalized gate checked by the producer
